title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu the little duck! The words light up with the music, and Lulu's friends join in for the second verse.

A classic nursery rhyme (words by Jane Taylor, 1806) for children aged 3 to 6.
